headline.purpose: Page H1 only, on phone (below 768px): 24px, balanced wrapping.

row-title.purpose: Task and thread titles in rows; underline on hover.

body.purpose: Base text; steps up to 15.5px below 768px. Sidebar view rows use the 14px UI size (`--fs-ui`).

body-sm.purpose: Alerts, details, empty states, button labels (500).

label.purpose: Uppercase mono panel headers (Ink Text), field labels and section labels, sidebar Pinned / Projects included (Slate).

meta.purpose: Row metadata, chips, hints, timestamps, task numbers; 11.5px (`--fs-meta-sm`) for small counts, panel meta and the sidebar marks' counts.

meta-line.purpose: Detail values, sidebar project titles and the // context line below the H1.

shadows.name: palette-overlay
shadows.purpose: Command palette on laptop only; the single cast shadow.

shadows.name: stat-selected
shadows.purpose: Selected stat strip cell, in its tone.

shadows.name: active-row
shadows.purpose: Active row box over a Bench Gray fill: the current sidebar row (views and the selected project; no side bar), and the highlighted palette, project combobox and snippet picker result. Inset, so rows never shift.

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused input/select ring with ink border.

shadows.name: checkbox-focus
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible checkbox: 1px Paper gap, 1px Ink ring.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.value: 150ms (browser default ease) on background-color, opacity, color, border-color, box-shadow, fill
motion.purpose: Hover and state changes only, including the brand mark's top step turning Waiting Yellow (none with reduced motion).

motion.name: overlay-fade
motion.value: 150ms opacity fade, no movement; none with reduced motion
motion.purpose: Toasts and the T3 status details card.

motion.name: pull-settle
motion.value: 180ms content settle back; skipped with reduced motion
motion.purpose: Pull to reload release or cancel.

motion.name: toast-dismiss
motion.value: 8s auto-dismiss, paused on hover or focus
motion.purpose: Done and failed toasts; needs-input toasts stay until acted on.

motion.name: busy-spin
motion.value: 12px square border spinner, 1.5px, top edge transparent; still with reduced motion
motion.purpose: Busy buttons and the reloading indicator.

motion.name: fold-rotate
motion.purpose: Group header folding and the sidebar's quiet projects disclosure.

motion.name: pin-reveal
motion.purpose: Sidebar pin slot revealed on row hover or focus; always shown when pinned and on touch.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Phone below: 40px controls, type roles step up about 1px, drawers become full-screen sheets.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar from here (248px); below it the 52px top bar and 56px bottom tabs; detail pages split into main and side columns.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Stat strip shows its "click a count to filter" hint.

themes.mechanism: prefers-color-scheme with :root[data-theme=light|dark] override; theme toggle cycles system, light, dark.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Laptop (1024px+) 248px sidebar: stepped-bars mark (top step Waiting Yellow while anything needs input), Ctrl K search beside a square primary New task, Lucide-icon views (Dashboard inbox, Tasks list-checks, Schedules calendar-clock), the project scope list and a Snippets / Settings footer. narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Ink Workbench"**

stage is a workbench, not a dashboard of cards. Every view is a stack of ruled, square-cornered panels on a white (light) or deep slate (dark) ground, each headed by a tinted bar with an uppercase mono label, each holding hairline-separated rows. The chrome is ink and hairline only: black-on-white primary actions in light mode, near-white-on-near-black in dark. Color is withheld until a task's state earns it, so the one yellow on screen is always the thing waiting on the user.

Density is high and deliberate: 14.5px body, 32px controls (40px on phone), 8-10px row padding, 14px between panels. Geist carries titles, actions and prose; JetBrains Mono carries everything that is metadata (project names, models, times, counts in rows, labels, chips, keycaps). The direction refuses the rounded-card SaaS dashboard and the neon-terminal costume: it reads like an instrument panel drawn with a ruler, lit only where attention is owed.

Motion is quiet: 150ms color, opacity and border transitions on state change, a pulsing skeleton while loading, a square spinner on busy buttons, and no entrance choreography.
keyCharacteristics: Zero radius on every element, including chips, markers, spinners and focus outlines.
1px hairlines (11% ink) separate rows and regions; 20% ink outlines controls.
Ink accent that inverts per theme; no brand hue in chrome (the mark's yellow top step is a needs-input marker, not brand color).
Six state tones (need, run, done, ok, bad, idle) drawn as tinted borders, square markers and colored text.
Uppercase JetBrains Mono panel headers on a light-gray bar.
Drawers and full-screen sheets instead of modals.

rules.name: The State Earns Color Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only on a state: a chip, a square marker, a stat count, an alert, the needs-input row edge, or the mark's top step while anything needs input. Chrome, navigation, links and primary buttons stay ink.

rules.name: The Two-Token Tone Rule
rules.body: Every tone sets a marker/border color and a text color. Borders mix the tone at 45-55% into transparent, fills at 8-14%; the need chip fills at 14% so yellow reads at a glance. Never invent a tone outside the six.

rules.name: The One Yellow Edge Rule
rules.body: User-approved: a task row in needs input carries a 2px Waiting Yellow left edge and makes its primary action "Open in T3". It is the only colored row edge in the system; every other row keeps a transparent 2px edge so titles align. The same edge marks a needs-input toast, an inbox row whose task or thread is still waiting, and the Needs input panel while something still waits on the user.

rules.name: The Mono Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono for project names, models, times, ids, counts, chips, labels, keycaps; Geist for titles, actions and prose. Counts, times and step numbers use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Meta Below Rule
rules.body: A page's context line sits directly below the H1 in 12px mono Slate, led by a bold Ink Text `//`. Nothing sits above a heading: no eyebrow, no kicker.

rules.name: The Ruled List Rule
rules.body: One bordered panel per state or concern, rows separated by hairlines. Never a grid of cards.

rules.name: The Drawer Not Modal Rule
rules.body: Secondary flows (new task, edit, filters, More) open in a right drawer, 580px or 680px wide, that becomes a full-screen sheet below 768px, with Esc, a focus trap and focus restore.

rules.name: The Safe Area Rule
rules.body: The page sets `viewport-fit=cover`, so anything pinned to a screen edge on phone pads itself with `env(safe-area-inset-*)`: the phone top bar (top), bottom tabs, task detail action bar and toasts (bottom), and every drawer sheet and the command palette (header top, footer or body bottom, sides in landscape). Primary actions never sit on the home indicator.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. Only the floating palette may; everything else separates by hairline and bar tint.

rules.name: The Zero Radius Rule
rules.body: No element rounds a corner. A circle is never a state marker; the marker is a square.

dos: Do keep every corner at 0px, including chips, markers, spinners and focus outlines.
Do separate rows and regions with 1px Hairline and outline controls with Strong Hairline.
Do color only what a state earns: chips, square markers, stat counts, alerts, the needs-input edge.
Do draw tones with the two-token pattern: border at 45-55% tone, fill at 8-14%, text in the tone's text color.
Do place the `//` meta line directly below the H1 in 12px mono Slate with a bold Ink Text `//`.
Do head every panel with the 32px Bench Gray bar and an uppercase 11px mono label at 0.12em.
Do set titles, actions and prose in Geist; set metadata, labels, chips, counts and keycaps in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do take icons from Lucide through `icons.tsx`: square caps, miter joins, constant 1.33px stroke, currentColor.
Do open secondary flows in a 580px (or 680px) right drawer that becomes a full-screen sheet below 768px.
Do keep motion to 150ms color, opacity and border transitions on state change.
Do give needs-input rows (and still-waiting needs-input toasts, inbox rows and the Needs input panel) the 2px Waiting Yellow left edge and a primary Open in T3; it is the only colored row edge.
donts: Don't give chrome, navigation, links or primary buttons a hue; the accent is ink and inverts per theme.
Don't set text in the bright need yellow; use `need-fg`.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
Don't use a text glyph as an icon; draw an SVG. Keycap legends inside a Kbd are key names, not icons.
Don't lay lists out as card grids or shadowed tiles; one ruled panel per state.
Don't cast shadows from surfaces; only the floating command palette has one. Toasts stay flat.
Don't use circles or dots as state markers; markers are squares.
Don't add colored left edges to any row other than needs input.
Don't add entrance animations or choreography.
Don't dress it as a neon terminal (glow, green-on-black, scanlines) or as a rounded-card SaaS dashboard.
